Name: Kaydwessie's Extra Conversation Topics (DEPRECIATED)
Author: Dwessie
Description:
Kaydwessie's Extra Dialogue Topics is an addon for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10008]More Conversation Topics[/url] by violetlizabet! It is based on Lumisteria's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10009]Villagers React To Marriage[/url] mod, so big shoutout to both of these creators!!


So? What does it even do?
Kaydwessie's Extra Conversation topics adds dialogue for everyone in vanilla Stardew Valley! Villagers will react to:
[list]
[*]The Luau, if it went super amazingly, or super terribly [s]and if you added something you found in Marnie's room[/s]
[*]Your wedding!
[*]Babies! (Different reactions per gender...for most people)
[*]Divorce!
[/list]
KNOWN BUG:
[list]
[*]Your spouse will congratulate you as if you were literally anyone else.  If you don't want that, you can use GenericModConfig to turn off their dialogue.
[*]Don't dig too deep in the content.json there's extra dialogues that point to nothing right now because they were from an ambitious idea I haven't finished yet
[/list]
Some neat things!
[list]
[*]Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfig[/url]﻿ so you can disable anyone's dialogue if you don't want theirs on for whatever reason. (I won't judge)
[*]Compatible with ENA and anyone else I might ever release.
[*]Your spouse's friends and family will have special reactions to you marrying them, if they have friends and family. (The list of friends and family is based on the Stardew Valley Wiki)
[*]Please look at Vincent's wedding dialogue I laugh every time I read it.
[/list]
Possible things to do if there's demand and/or I just...decide to:
[list]
[*]SDE and/or Ridgeside village compatibility (Not there yet cause I don't use those)
[*]Anyone's custom NPC can be added if they ask. Why not?
[*]Finish that ambitious idea I had lol
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Added Leo, Krobus, and the Dwarf. Added more conversation topics.
